description:
Edge inputs: Unicode text (multi-byte, combining, wide, RTL, ZWJ, BOM, no-break space) in data,
file names, IFS, patterns, case mapping and every text filter.

Generated from fixed tables with plain loops, so every Python 3 produces the same scripts.
